clockModel.cpuProfileStart: Profile event ts; args.data.startTime is intentionally ignored because it is CLOCK_MONOTONIC
clockModel.sampleIntervalRule: Accumulate signed raw V8 deltas from Profile head ts, sort sample points by timestamp/sample ID/original index, then use nonnegative gaps to the previous chronological point as backward weights. The first point has no inferred interval; crossing intervals remain boundary-unattributed.
clockModel.ancestryCrossCheck: Sample point timestamps and measured-script ancestry are reported per update as an independent trace-clock bridge check
